mapper.select: SELECT config_key AS row_id, config_key, value, input_type, name, description, group_cd, sort_no::TEXT AS sort_no, public_yn, use_yn FROM config_item WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(group_cd, 'ZZZ'), sort_no, config_key
SELECT config_key AS row_id, config_key, value, input_type FROM config_item WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND public_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY config_key
SELECT value FROM config_item WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT config_key, value FROM config_item WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
